description: This file defines custom domain-specific error classes for a Python backend API, including different types of errors with associated HTTP statuses and a base class for all domain errors.

classes.name: DomainError

classes.name: InvalidInputError

classes.name: GateFailureDomainError
classes.description: Represents a 422 Unprocessable Entity error related to gate failures.
